guide.text: Lobo's signature gear. Increases Crit Rate. Casting the Ultimate increases Physical Penetration for a set duration. Also increases basic attack damage. When taking lethal damage for the first time, HP is set to 1 and immediately restores a portion of max HP. Can be triggered once per battle.
